query:
SELECT
          o.ZREMINDER AS "reminder_row_id!",
          label.ZNAME AS "tag_name!"
        FROM ZREMCDOBJECT o
        JOIN ZREMCDHASHTAGLABEL label ON o.ZHASHTAGLABEL = label.Z_PK
        WHERE o.ZMARKEDFORDELETION = 0
          AND o.Z_ENT = ?
          AND o.ZREMINDER IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
